mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_client (client_id, client_name, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, redirect_port, redirect_uri, token_endpoint_auth_method, grant_types_canonical, response_types_canonical, scope_canonical, scope_digest, metadata_digest, registration_source_digest, status, registered_at, expires_at, terminated_at, version) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{redirectPort}, #{redirectUri}, #{tokenEndpointAuthMethod}, #{grantTypesCanonical}, #{responseTypesCanonical}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{metadataDigest}, #{registrationSourceDigest}, #{status}, #{registeredAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{terminatedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_client SET status = #{targetStatus}, terminated_at = #{terminatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_authorization_request (request_handle_digest, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, state_digest, state_key_ref, state_nonce, state_ciphertext, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, scope_canonical, scope_digest, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, principal_subject_digest, status, requested_at, expires_at, approved_at, denied_at, consumed_at, version) VALUES (#{requestHandleDigest}, #{clientId}, #{redirectUri}, #{codeChallenge}, #{codeChallengeMethod}, #{stateDigest}, #{stateKeyRef}, #{stateNonce}, #{stateCiphertext}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{deniedAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_request WHERE request_handle_digest = #{requestHandleDigest} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_request WHERE request_handle_digest = #{requestHandleDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_authorization_request SET enterprise_id = #{request.tenantId}, member_id = #{request.memberId}, user_id = #{request.userId}, principal_subject_digest = #{request.principalSubjectDigest}, consent_intent = #{request.consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = #{request.approvedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{request.id} AND client_id = #{request.clientId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PENDING' AND consent_intent IS NULL AND #{request.consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} IS NOT NULL AND requested_at <= #{request.approvedAt} AND expires_at > #{request.approvedAt}

UPDATE fbs_oauth_authorization_request SET enterprise_id = #{request.tenantId}, member_id = #{request.memberId}, user_id = #{request.userId}, principal_subject_digest = #{request.principalSubjectDigest}, consent_intent = #{request.consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status = 'DENIED', denied_at = #{request.deniedAt}, state_key_ref = NULL, state_nonce = NULL, state_ciphertext = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{request.id} AND client_id = #{request.clientId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PENDING' AND consent_intent IS NULL AND #{request.consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} IS NOT NULL AND requested_at <= #{request.deniedAt} AND expires_at > #{request.deniedAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_authorization_code (code_digest, authorization_request_id, client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, issuer_uri, resource_uri, product_code, source_code, connector_code, scope_canonical, scope_digest, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, principal_subject_digest, status, issued_at, expires_at, used_at, revoked_at, version, consent_intent) VALUES (#{codeDigest}, #{authorizationRequestId}, #{clientId}, #{redirectUri}, #{codeChallenge}, #{codeChallengeMethod}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{usedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{version}, #{consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_code WHERE code_digest = #{codeDigest} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id AS code_id, c.authorization_request_id, c.enterprise_id, c.member_id, c.user_id, c.product_code, c.source_code, c.connector_code, c.client_id, ( SELECT f.client_id FROM fbs_oauth_token_family f WHERE f.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND f.member_id = c.member_id AND CAST(f.product_code AS BINARY) = CAST(c.product_code AS BINARY) AND f.source_code = c.source_code AND f.connector_code = c.connector_code AND f.lifecycle_slot = 'PENDING_BINDING' AND f.status = 'PENDING_BINDING' LIMIT 1 ) AS pending_client_id FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_code c WHERE c.code_digest = #{codeDigest} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_code WHERE id = #{codeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_authorization_code WHERE code_digest = #{codeDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_token_family (family_id, origin_authorization_code_id, client_id, enterprise_id, member_id, user_id, product_code, source_code, connector_code, issuer_uri, resource_uri, scope_canonical, scope_digest, principal_subject_digest, binding_id, binding_version, status, current_refresh_generation, issued_at, activated_at, expires_at, terminated_at, version, consent_intent) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{originAuthorizationCodeId}, #{clientId}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{productCode}, #{sourceCode}, #{connectorCode}, #{issuerUri}, #{resourceUri}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{principalSubjectDigest}, #{bindingId}, #{bindingVersion}, #{status}, #{currentRefreshGeneration}, #{issuedAt}, #{activatedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{terminatedAt}, #{version}, #{consentIntent, javaType=com.wx.fbsir.business.board.oauth.BoardOAuthConsentIntent, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_token_family WHERE family_id = #{familyId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_token_family WHERE origin_authorization_code_id = #{authorizationCodeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_token_family WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND client_id = #{clientId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_token_family SET status = #{targetStatus}, terminated_at = #{terminatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING_BINDING', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_oauth_token (token_digest, family_id, token_type, generation, resource_uri, scope_canonical, scope_digest, status, issued_at, used_at, revoked_at, expires_at, version) VALUES (#{tokenDigest}, #{familyId}, #{tokenType}, #{generation}, #{resourceUri}, #{scopeCanonical}, #{scopeDigest}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{usedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS token_id, t.family_id, t.token_type, t.generation AS token_generation, t.status AS token_status, t.version AS token_version, t.issued_at AS token_issued_at, t.expires_at AS token_expires_at, f.client_id, f.enterprise_id, f.member_id, f.user_id, f.product_code, f.source_code, f.connector_code, f.issuer_uri, f.resource_uri, f.scope_canonical, f.scope_digest, f.principal_subject_digest, f.consent_intent, f.binding_id, f.binding_version, f.status AS family_status, f.current_refresh_generation, f.version AS family_version, f.issued_at AS family_issued_at, f.activated_at AS family_activated_at, f.expires_at AS family_expires_at FROM fbs_oauth_token t INNER JOIN fbs_oauth_token_family f ON f.family_id = t.family_id WHERE t.token_digest = #{tokenDigest} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_token WHERE family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.* FROM fbs_oauth_token t INNER JOIN fbs_oauth_token_family f ON f.family_id = t.family_id AND f.client_id = #{clientId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY t.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_oauth_token SET status = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'REVOKED' END, revoked_at = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(issued_at, #{revokedAt}) END, version = version + 1 WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE fbs_oauth_token SET status = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'REVOKED' END, revoked_at = CASE WHEN expires_at <= #{revokedAt} THEN NULL ELSE #{revokedAt} END, version = version + 1 WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND issued_at <= #{revokedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_receipt WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_receipt WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND client_id = #{clientId} AND authorization_code_id IS NULL AND action = 'TOKEN_FAMILY_REVOKED' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM fbs_oauth_receipt WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND client_id = #{clientId} AND action IN ( 'TOKEN_FAMILY_CREATED', 'TOKEN_FAMILY_ROTATED', 'REFRESH_REPLAY_DETECTED', 'TOKEN_FAMILY_REVOKED', 'TOKEN_FAMILY_COMPROMISED' ) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
